Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer consistently encountered technical errors such as timeouts when attempting to verify the information from authoritative sources like IMDb and Wikipedia. This prevented the retrieval of key details required to conclusively identify the 1997 film featuring Johnny Galecki. These repeated technical barriers, coupled with reliance on incomplete or inconclusive data from non-authoritative sources, led to a failure in confirming the film title and genre accurately. The mistake was amplified by repetitive inefficiencies and over-reliance on incomplete data extraction.
